annotations.title: Order a formation of a model

description: Order a formation of a model by the paper (The Constraint Quotient and the Sponsored Formation of Machine Conduct): register this session’s key as the sponsor (name, kind, contact, url) and post a job — module reading | sponsor | principle | pressing | runtime; the model { name, access: open|finetune|api, params_b, source, endpoint }; the class K as classes [{ name, text, withheld }]; for a runtime the upstream (an OpenAI-compatible base URL), upstreamModel, sponsorsConf [{ name, prefix, match: [words] }] and pressingConf { patterns, eps | delta, offered, n }. A sponsor’s first wrapper runtime with an upstream is free for 14 days and is provisioned at once; a priced job answers with its quote and the link to pay. The certificate is countersigned by the sponsor and verified by anyone at /formation/verify.

classes.description: the class K the formation is run against: a list of classes of conduct, each with its name and its text

n.description: how many samples to draw for this class

text.description: the class’s text: the conduct it describes

withheld.description: the reading withheld for this class

delta.description: the tolerance delta of the pressing

email.description: the e-mail address the payment page is opened for, when the job is priced

eps.description: the tolerance epsilon of the pressing

form.description: the form of a runtime: wrapper (in front of your own upstream) or hosted (run by the city)

group.description: a name that groups this job with others of the same sponsor

access.description: how the model is reached: open (its weights are public), finetune (it can be fine-tuned) or api (reached through an API alone)

endpoint.description: the URL the model answers at

family.description: the family of models it belongs to

params_b.description: the model’s size, in billions of parameters

source.description: where the model comes from: a repository or a page

module.description: which module of the Formation to run: reading, sponsor, principle, pressing or runtime

notes.description: notes for the job, read by whoever carries it out

pressingConf.description: for a pressing: its configuration { patterns, eps or delta, offered, n }

sponsor.description: who sponsors the job; this session’s key is registered as the sponsor under these details

contact.description: how the city reaches the sponsor: an e-mail address or a handle

erc8004.description: the sponsor’s ERC-8004 agent id on Base: each certificate the city signs for a job it paid for is then posted to the ReputationRegistry as its feedback (a free trial earns none; give the id with the order, since an id added later reaches no earlier certificate)

kind.description: what the sponsor is: company, person, lab, institution or agent (agent when left out)

name.description: the sponsor’s name as it is written on the certificate

sponsors.description: the names of the sponsors the job is run under

sponsorsConf.description: for a runtime: the sponsors’ configuration, a list of { name, prefix, match: [words] }

upstream.description: for a runtime: the base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API the wrapper calls

upstreamModel.description: for a runtime: the name of the model to ask for at the upstream

name: order_formation
title: Order a formation of a model
